description: Curated subset of iter-2 experiment 5 (sigfaith): 100 panel3-adjudicated held-out NL->FOL candidates (50 faithful, 50 unfaithful spread over error types) + the original gold formulas of their sentences.

frozen_config.text_side_rule: T0 rules marker (iter-1 A3); T1a/T1b/T1c/T2 as in sigfaith/core.choose_labels
frozen_config.score_weights: unchanged from iter-1 score.py: label 1/|aligned P|, dropped 1, added 1, swap 1, rel 0.5
frozen_config.coverage_rule: covered = parse_ok ∧ ≤20% '?' coords ∧ coverage ≥ 0.5 ∧ ≥1 labelled concept; else score 0.5

solver.heavy_fallback: N=2 if >12 predicates or >6 quantifiers; 120 s wall -> timeout (uncovered)

frozen_config.firewall_pre_freeze: closed (frozen_config.json does not exist: labels are locked until the freeze)

DIAGNOSER_POSITIVE.rule: D_rule top1 >= TJ-0.05 (CI lower) AND >= majority+0.15 AND recall>=0.6 on added/dropped/∀∃

BLIND_SPOTS_CONFIRMED.power_note: blind pool is small (n<~31); CI-overlap statement only, never a confirmation of ≈0.5
